name: small_oven
recommended_playback: play close and open at about 0.5-0.6 s each (speed up as needed)

close.note: door swings shut, last frame = closed, ends with a small latch bounce

open.note: door swings open, last frame = open and ready for the open-hold

notes: Frame 'closed' is the single static closed frame. Use it while cooking.
Frame 'open_hold' (last frame) is the single static open frame. Use it while the oven is open.
The first frame of the open clip may still show a small flame remnant at the door edge.

item_slots_full_res.note: Oven floor in the body frame (full-res pixels). Use ONE tray (slot_a) or TWO smaller items (slot_b1 and slot_b2). Decide per game design.

body.door_clip_note: open clip starts after the flames are gone.

notes: Draw this layer on top of the closed door while cooking. Play intro once then loop.
On READY: fade the flame layer out in about 0.2 s, then play the door open clip.
